name: @transcodes-guard/core
description: Host-agnostic public core of transcodes-guard — contract/ (DI contract), stepup/ (gate logic), server/ (createServer MCP surface), patterns/ (danger-pattern/tool-rule registry), hosts/ (per-host wire adapters), paths/ (state paths), consolidated into one workspace package with per-domain subpath exports. The backend stays behind getGateBackend(); only @transcodes-guard/gate-backend remains a separate package (import-firewalled, separate CDN bundle unit).
